name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] <short description>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve, or what does it enable?

## Proposed approach

If you have one, describe how it might work (API, configuration, affected
modules). Sketches and examples are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional context

Links to references (papers, other networks' practices), affected instrument
types, or anything else relevant.
